description: `CooldownService` is a small, category-free cooldown package. A cooldown belongs to any `Instance` and a case-sensitive string key, so the same API can cover combat moves, tools, interactions, UI, matchmaking, or any other temporary lockout.

Client/CooldownBindersClient.luau.description: Provides the replicated and predicted client Cooldown binder.

Client/CooldownClient.luau.description: Read-only client model for one replicated or locally predicted cooldown. Public entry points include `CooldownClient.new`.

CooldownService.luau.description: Creates, queries, observes, and expires authoritative cooldowns attached to arbitrary Instance owners. Public entry points include `CooldownService.Init`, `CooldownService.StartCooldown`, `CooldownService.StartTypedCooldown`, `CooldownService.RestartCooldown`, `CooldownService.GetCooldown`, `CooldownService.IsOnCooldown`, `CooldownService.GetRemainingTime`, `CooldownService.ObserveCooldown`.

CooldownServiceClient.luau.description: Queries replicated cooldowns and owns optional local client predictions. Public entry points include `CooldownServiceClient.Init`, `CooldownServiceClient.GetCooldown`, `CooldownServiceClient.IsOnCooldown`, `CooldownServiceClient.GetRemainingTime`, `CooldownServiceClient.ObserveCooldown`, `CooldownServiceClient.ObserveIsOnCooldown`, `CooldownServiceClient.PredictCooldown`, `CooldownServiceClient.PredictTypedCooldown`.

Server/Cooldown.luau.description: Authoritative server model for one tagged cooldown Folder. Public entry points include `Cooldown.new`, `Cooldown.Restart`, `Cooldown.AddTime`, `Cooldown.RemoveTime`, `Cooldown.Clear`.

Server/CooldownBindersServer.luau.description: Provides the authoritative server Cooldown binder.

Server/CooldownBurstTracker.luau.description: Tracks successful typed cooldown starts in rolling owner/key windows. Public entry points include `CooldownBurstTracker.new`, `CooldownBurstTracker.RecordUse`, `CooldownBurstTracker.Reset`, `CooldownBurstTracker.Destroy`.

Shared/CooldownBase.luau.description: Shared read-only behavior for one tagged cooldown Folder. Public entry points include `CooldownBase.new`, `CooldownBase.GetFolder`, `CooldownBase.GetState`, `CooldownBase.GetOwner`, `CooldownBase.GetKey`, `CooldownBase.GetStartedAt`, `CooldownBase.GetEndsAt`, `CooldownBase.GetDuration`.

Shared/CooldownClockService.luau.description: Owns CooldownService's synchronized realm clock and hides TimeSyncService wiring from cooldown models and public helpers. Public entry points include `CooldownClockService.Init`, `CooldownClockService.GetTime`.

Shared/CooldownExpiryScheduler.luau.description: Schedules all cooldown expirations through one minimum heap and one heartbeat. Public entry points include `CooldownExpiryScheduler.new`, `CooldownExpiryScheduler.Schedule`, `CooldownExpiryScheduler.Cancel`, `CooldownExpiryScheduler.Step`, `CooldownExpiryScheduler.Destroy`.

Shared/CooldownRegistry.luau.description: Maintains constant-time owner/key cooldown lookup and reactive selection over all models produced by one realm's Cooldown binder. Public entry points include `CooldownRegistry.new`, `CooldownRegistry.Register`, `CooldownRegistry.Unregister`, `CooldownRegistry.Get`, `CooldownRegistry.Observe`, `CooldownRegistry.Destroy`.

Shared/CooldownServiceConstants.luau.description: Shared attribute names, binder tag, and defaults for CooldownService.

Shared/CooldownServiceTypes.luau.description: Shared contracts for cooldown state, clocks, and expiry scheduling.

Shared/CooldownServiceUtils.luau.description: Validates cooldown data, creates tagged cooldown Folders, and provides the small heap operations used by the shared expiry scheduler. Public entry points include `CooldownServiceUtils.isFiniteNumber`, `CooldownServiceUtils.isDuration`, `CooldownServiceUtils.isCooldownKey`, `CooldownServiceUtils.isDefaultCooldownValue`, `CooldownServiceUtils.isBurstCooldownValue`,…
